tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind non-camera screens (library, viewer, settings).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows on ground: ScanCard, DeviceCard, SettingRow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised fills inside a surface: segmented tracks, StatTile, Sheet body, secondary Button.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Every panel that sits on the live camera feed: StatusBar, CoachPrompt, bottom control dock, glass IconButton. Never draw text straight on the camera image.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Glass panels that carry warnings or long text over the camera.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around thumbnails. Decorative only in dark; meets 3:1 in outdoor.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: control outlines, unselected segments, input edges. 3:1 or more on ground, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface, surface-2 and glass (14:1 or more dark, 17:1 outdoor).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, descriptions, stat labels. On ground, surface, surface-2 and glass.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata and placeholder text. On ground, surface, surface-2 and glass (4.7:1 worst case dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: ambr's one colour: shutter, primary Button, selected segment, progress fills, focus ring and under-covered regions in the fog overlay. One accent-filled control per view.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Never white.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for selected rows, accent chips and the inside of under-covered regions in the overlay.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: The fog of war: base tint over parts of the scene that are not scanned yet.

tokens.name: fog-hatch
tokens.usage: 45° hatch lines drawn over fog so unscanned areas read even on dark scenes and for colour-blind users.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Positive status: tracking good, device connected, scan ready. Cyan, not green, so it is never confused with err. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution: tracking limited, moving too fast, low storage. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Failure: tracking lost, upload failed, processing error. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: The recording dot and the stop square inside the shutter only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and D-pad focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles on library and viewer. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet titles, scan names on detail screens.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segment labels, stat labels.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Hero stats on review: coverage, keyframes, size.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Live readouts in StatusBar, CoverageMeter, progress ETAs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inner padding of chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Glass panel padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top margin of screen titles.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Bottom safe gap above the gesture bar on capture.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, thumbnails, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segments, inputs, StatTile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels, cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the capture dock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: CoachPrompt, StatusChip, toggles, the shutter.

size.note: Android touch targets are 48dp minimum; capture controls are larger because they are used while walking.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for every control.

tokens.name: target-capture
tokens.usage: IconButtons on the capture screen.

tokens.name: shutter
tokens.usage: Shutter button diameter.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: ScanCard thumbnail.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets rising over content. Outdoor uses a line-strong border instead.
